name: Poppy Patel
source:
Poppy Patel is a junior fashion editor at Motif and Your Character's best friend. She is first seen in Book 1, Chapter 1.

Poppy calls Your Character her best friend in the world and it is mentioned that they went to college together, meeting each other during freshman year. In Book 1, Chapter 2 she says that Your Character's powers are incredible and suggests to do some flying. If Your Character does so, they can take a photo of her at the top of Northbridge Tower. Although she supports Your Character's career as a Superhero, she is often concerned about the danger they put themself in. If the player allows her to, she designs Your Character's Superhero costume. They traditionally get dinner together every Monday night, and in Book 1, Chapter 13, it is mentioned that they have been friends for at least 5 years.

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Poppy_Patel]Wiki[/url]]
